findings.claim: The diff changes `shelfTitle` in frontend/src/components/videoapp/labels.ts, a file the touch-point list does not name. Together with VideoShelfPage now passing `label: ""`, this leaves the title of a Video `by=tag` See all page empty.
findings.impact: A user who opens See all on a tag shelf in the Video Library (group by Tag, then See all) sees a page with an empty heading where the tag name used to be. The spec says the See all page's title stays unchanged.
findings.evidence: frontend/src/components/videoapp/VideoShelfPage.tsx:201 now calls `shelfTitle({ by, shelf: { key: shelfKey, label: "" }, ... })`. Before, it passed `label: shelfKey`. In frontend/src/components/videoapp/labels.ts:41 the `by === "tag"` branch returns `shelf.label`, which is now "" for every key except `no_tag`. Folder titles still work because labels.ts:37-39 fall back to the key, and month titles still work because labels.ts:42 uses `shelf.label || shelf.key`. The tag branch has no such fallback. VideoShelfPage.test.tsx covers titles only for folder and all (lines 130, 138, 239-247), so nothing pins the tag title.
findings.repro: Mutation reasoning: render `<VideoShelfPage drive="main" by="tag" shelfKey="Trip" />`. `shelfTitle` returns "" from labels.ts:41, so the header heading is empty. Before this commit it was "Trip". No existing test would fail.

bucket_proposal.reason: No declared invariant covers the See all title. Spec §1 (Video) says 'Its title and back link are unchanged', and this commit breaks that through a file outside the touch-point list.

findings.proposed_fix: In VideoShelfPage, pass `label: shelfKey` again, or make the tag branch of `shelfTitle` fall back to `shelf.key`. Add a title test for `by="tag"`.

findings.claim: The diff changes the shared frontend/src/components/ToolbarMenu.tsx, adding the `inlineLabel` and `onOpenChange` props and routing every open/close through `changeOpen`. ToolbarMenu.tsx is not in the touch-point list.
findings.impact: Every ToolbarMenu in the app now goes through the new `changeOpen` path. The toggle changed from `setOpen((s) => !s)` to `changeOpen(!open)`, which reads `open` from the render closure. I traced no defect from this, but the shared-component change was not planned and is outside the declared review surface.
findings.evidence: frontend/src/components/ToolbarMenu.tsx:174,181,188-196,220,256-262. FilterMenus.tsx is the only caller of `inlineLabel` and `onOpenChange` in the diff. toolbarMenuHome.test.ts adds FilterMenus.tsx as an importer, but no ToolbarMenu test covers the new props.

bucket_proposal.reason: Unplanned touch point. No invariant is broken.

findings.claim: frontend/src/components/videoapp/VideoPagedGrid.tsx gains a `filtered` prop and a separate filtered-empty branch, and the touch-point list does not name this file.
findings.impact: The None grid in Video and the Video See all page share this component. The empty-state branching changed for both: the See all page passes no `filtered`, so it keeps `no-files`. This matches I10, but the file was not planned.
findings.evidence: frontend/src/components/videoapp/VideoPagedGrid.tsx (diff hunk: `empty` and `ready && items.length === 0` are now separate branches). The only callers are videoapp/LibraryFace.tsx and VideoShelfPage.tsx:248.

bucket_proposal.reason: Unplanned touch point. Its behaviour matches I10.

findings.claim: The Reading reset-on-Target-choice and drive-replace logic is in frontend/src/components/readingapp/useReadingApp.ts, which is not listed. The listed `readingapp/ReadingApp.tsx` is not changed by the diff.
findings.impact: Readers who follow the touch-point list to check I5 for Reading would look in ReadingApp.tsx and miss where the reset actually happens.
findings.evidence: frontend/src/components/readingapp/useReadingApp.ts: a new `useEffect` calls `readLibraryFilters("reading", drive)`, and `chooseTarget` calls `resetLibraryFilters`. ReadingApp.tsx does not appear in the diff.

findings.claim: Several pieces of test infrastructure outside the listed test scopes are changed: the global test setup frontend/src/test/setup.ts (it now resets the module-level filter store after every test), frontend/src/__tests__/popup-dismissal.test.ts, readingVideoLayoutFixtureParity.test.tsx, viewMenus.wording.test.tsx, and the e2e-components projects.ts and spec-viewport.spec.ts registries.
findings.impact: setup.ts now resets the `video` and `reading` filter entries after every test in the frontend suite. A test that relied on filters surviving across tests, or one written for another app id, would behave differently. The other files are registries or expectation updates.
findings.evidence: frontend/src/test/setup.ts afterEach: `resetLibraryFilters("video", "")` and `resetLibraryFilters("reading", "")`. popup-dismissal.test.ts moves its entry key to appshell/FilterMenus.tsx. projects.ts and spec-viewport.spec.ts register library-filters(-desktop).spec.ts.

bucket_proposal.reason: Unplanned touch points in test infrastructure. No invariant is broken.

findings.claim: The shared Clips test harness predicate `isNewShelf` in addons/knowledge/frontend/__tests__/clipsAppHarness.tsx was loosened so that a `by=all` shelves call with `trust` counts as Home's New shelf when `per_shelf=60`.
findings.impact: Every Clips test that uses `isNewShelf` now classifies a 60-item `by=all` call with `trust` as the New shelf. A regression where a Home-side call starts carrying `trust` at `per_shelf=60` would be matched instead of rejected.

bucket_proposal.reason: Shared test helper weakened outside the Clips Library tests it was meant for. No invariant is broken by the code itself.
